convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom indicator 'BlauSMStochastic' and depends on two external .mqh libraries (SmoothAlgorithms.mqh, TradeAlgorithms.mqh) for smoothing algorithms and trade execution logic. Custom indicator with multi-stage smoothing cannot be auto-converted.

indicators.name: BlauSMStochastic
indicators.derived_period: min_rates_total = GetStartBars(XMA_Method,XLength,XPhase) + GetStartBars(XMA_Method,XLength1,XPhase) + GetStartBars(XMA_Method,XLength2,XPhase) + GetStartBars(XMA_Method,XLength3,XPhase) + GetStartBars(XMA_Method,XLength4,XPhase) + 3 + SignalBar

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars for indicator warmup
TimeShiftSec - timeframe duration in seconds
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime/DnSignalTime calculation for trade execution timing

other_exits: Opposite signal closes existing position: buy signal triggers SELL_Close, sell signal triggers BUY_Close, gated by BuyPosClose/SellPosClose input booleans

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MMMode enum (LOT=lot-based, other modes from MarginMode enum in TradeAlgorithms.mqh). MM=0.1 is either lot size or risk fraction depending on MMMode. BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen from TradeAlgorithms.mqh handle sizing internally.

custom_logic_notes: Three trading modes selected via AlgMode enum: (1) 'breakdown' - histogram crosses zero line; (2) 'twist' - histogram direction change (3-bar comparison: Hist[0]>Hist[1] when Hist[1]<Hist[2] for buy, Hist[0]<Hist[1] when Hist[1]>Hist[2] for sell); (3) 'cloudtwist' - cloud crossover of upper/lower indicator buffers. SignalBar input (default=1) shifts signal evaluation back by N bars. Recount flag ensures signal recalculated on failure. BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/SellPosClose/BuyPosClose booleans independently gate each trade action. GlobalVariableDel_ called on deinit for cleanup.
python_conversion_notes: Must reimplement the BlauSMStochastic custom indicator which uses 5-stage smoothing via CXMA class from SmoothAlgorithms.mqh (supports EMA/SMA/SMMA/LWMA/JJMA/VIDYA/AMA). Trade execution functions (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose) come from TradeAlgorithms.mqh and must be reimplemented with proper position management. The three AlgMode variants each have distinct signal logic. SignalBar=1 means signals are evaluated on the previous completed bar - critical for backtesting alignment. The UpSignalTime/DnSignalTime mechanism likely prevents duplicate entries within the same bar period.
